title: Strong-scaling parallel efficiency across 1–64 nodes
what: At 64 nodes NCCL retains 81.2% efficiency vs 21.9% for Gloo-TCP (+59.3 pp lead, 5 runs)

reader_questions.question: What scaling efficiency does NCCL maintain at 64 nodes vs Gloo-TCP?
How is run-to-run variability reported?
reader_questions.expected: Mean ± SD/CI across 5 runs per node count.

reader_questions.question: Where does Gloo-TCP begin collapsing rapidly?
reader_questions.expected: Past 8–16 nodes, dropping from 72% at 8 nodes to ~22% at 64 nodes.
